identification: Wellsaw Model 404 (sold in the US as the Jarvis Wellsaw 404) heavy-duty electric reciprocating breaking saw for meat/carcass processing, 16 in style blade, Wells Manufacturing Corp, Three Rivers, Michigan; 230 V AC/DC 3.5 A version, serial 22219. Electric, not pneumatic as the catalogue says. Front guide knob and rear pistol grip present, long heavy rubber cord with a non-Australian-looking connector at the end, blade heavily rusted, alloy body dirty and oxidised. Untested.
